voter.title: Voter login
voter.intro: Enter your Dhaka University registration number. We will email a 6-digit code to your university email address.
voter.regNoHint: Letters, digits and dashes only, e.g. 2021-415-123
voter.codeSent: If {{regNo}} is on the voter list, a 6-digit code has been sent to its university email. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
voter.resendIn: You can request a new code in {{seconds}} s
voter.resent: A new code has been sent if the number is on the voter list.
voter.neverShare: Never share this code with anyone, including candidates or EC staff.

admin.title: Election Commission / Observer login
admin.voterLink: Are you a voter? Log in with your registration number

sessionExpired: You were logged out after 15 minutes without activity. Please log in again.

errors.INVALID_CODE: That code is incorrect or has expired. Check the latest email or request a new code.
errors.OTP_COOLDOWN: Too many wrong codes. You can try again after {{time}}.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
